facts.business: Gokak Textiles Limited is engaged in the textile business with a Mills Division producing yarn, fabric, and garments, and has a subsidiary Gokak Power & Energy Limited engaged in hydro power generation.

segments.name: Power Generation (Subsidiary - Gokak Power & Energy Limited)

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The Company has incurred a net loss for the year ended March 31, 2026, current liabilities exceeded current assets, accumulated losses, negative net worth, reduced operations of textile division, and increased financial stress indicate material uncertainty that may cast significant doubt on the Company's ability to continue as a going concern. However, financial statements prepared on going concern basis based on reasons stated in Note 47. Opinion not modified in respect of this matter.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to net losses, negative net worth, current liabilities exceeding current assets
Reduced operations of textile division and increased financial stress
Impact of reciprocal tariffs by US (16% to 50%) on textile exports
Middle East conflict impacting raw material prices
Uncertainty in spinning industry with orders not flowing from clients
Dependence on holding company for loans (ICDs novated to holding company)
Accumulated losses in subsidiary Gokak Power & Energy Limited (Rs. 3,489.48 lakhs) indicating potential impairment of investment
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were on arm's length basis and in ordinary course of business. No materially significant related party transactions except sale of power to holding company approved by shareholders. Loans from related parties: Non-current loan of Rs. 956.85 lakhs from other related parties at 11.50% p.a. repayable on or after March 31, 2028; Current loan of Rs. 5,294.52 lakhs from Holding Company (Gokak Textiles Limited) at 11.50% p.a. repayable on demand (novated from ultimate holding company Shapoorji Pallonji & Company Private Limited). Perpetual loan of Rs. 80.00 lakhs from Evangelos Ventures Private Limited classified as instruments entirely equity in nature.
